title: qxmd158 · strip stem-echo after Check Answer (solution panel)
body: After Check Answer / Show Answer, QuantrexSolution.stripLeadingStemEcho removes a leading question-stem duplicate (and Marks DIFFICULTY/ANSWER meta) from solution HTML before Mx.html. Feedback shows correct-option result + clean explanation only — never re-prints the stem. Preserves qx-math-sanitize / Mx.html pipeline (qxmath1).
